svg.title: The Hexwarden, phase 2 of 3: enraged
svg.desc: The Hexwarden in phase 2, enraged, for levels 4 to 6. Nineteen glowing slit-pupil eyes are open on his visor, shoulders, chest and palms, his hexagonal rage core is lit, and the beaten server-key plate is shattered and reforming harder. Two beams lock onto the exact IL line the player is on and note that they hesitated. He says: you read a string, I read you. Rage 5 of 9.
